text_block_list.text:
On a day off, Мэйсё Дото, for some
reason, is
booked to compete in the
shopping district's
spicy-food-eating
contest...

Ngh... I thought I was filling out a
questionnaire,
but to think it was a
sign-up sheet all along...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
N-no, I sh-shouldn't... I would only be
causing
everyone trouble if I leave now.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I probably won't last too long, but I'll do
my best.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: It's time to announce the contestants! First up, we have a competitor ready to turn up the heat. Bringing in the passionate fuego of her Latin heritage, it's Эль Кондор Паса, everyone!
text_block_list.name: Event Host

text_block_list.text:
I've got the appetite and the speed to
put me on
top! And I brought my own
Salsa de la Vida to
further increase that
picante!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

Next up, she's challenging the spice with
guts and
gusto! A hot-blooded sister to
all, it's Hishi
Amazon!
text_block_list.name: Event Host

text_block_list.text:
Spicy stuff's my specialty! I'll come out
on top, no
matter the contest!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

And lastly... whoa there, looks like she's
got a
mild case of the jitters. Her
resistance to spice
shrouded in
mystery—it's Мэйсё Дото!
text_block_list.name: Event Host

text_block_list.text:
Ah, u-um... I p-pwomise to do my besht!
Oh no, I
messed up!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
And so, with the colorful cast now
introduced to
the crowd, the
competition kicks off.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
First up on the menu is a super spicy
ramen! We
had the noodles specially
made with chili
peppers, served up in a
bright-red broth!
Contenders, dig in!
text_block_list.name: Event Host

text_block_list.text:
Ack?! What is this stuff?! The spice level
has my
Salsa de la Vida beat by a mile!
Is this real?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Next, we're bringing in the super spicy
wings! The
plate's piled up so high, you
have to crane your
neck to see the top!
text_block_list.name: Event Host

text_block_list.text:
Eurgh! The coatin' is made completely
out of chili
peppers?! My tongue's 'bout
to shrivel up and fall
right off!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hm, now that you say that... I guess it's...
a little
spicy? But it's really delicious!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: What?! This is "a little spicy" to you?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
This is like torture, but you haven't even
winced!
What kinda trainin' did ya do to
prepare?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Oh no, no, no! I haven't trained for this
in the
slightest!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I'm honestly just a klutz! I've always had
this
problem of ordering spicy food by
mistake, so I'm
used to the taste—that's
all!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, looks like the tables have turned!
Meisho
Doto looks cool as a cucumber,
while her
competition struggles to bear
the heat!
text_block_list.name: Event Host

text_block_list.text:
Last on the menu is a super spicy mapo
tofu,
served piping hot! Who will be the
one to finish it
first? We're now entering
the final stretch!
text_block_list.name: Event Host

text_block_list.text:
Adrenaline is my middle name! I'll finish
this
competition with a bang and scarf it
down at full
speed!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, if it's speed you want, it's speed
you're
gonna get! I'm talking full
throttle, all systems
go—full speed
ahead!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I'm not so good at eating
quickly...
Wh-what should I do, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: Don't panic and go at your own pace.
Go for three times the speed!

text_block_list.text:
W-well... if I slow down, I don't think I'll
win... But,
o-okay, I'll try!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Grlagh... Nope! This is too spicy, even
for me! Let
me break for five or so!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Guh... I don't wanna admit it, but I'm
with her...
Please, some water!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Looks like two of our contestants are
asking for a
time-out.
Meanwhile—whaaaat?! You're not going

to believe this!
text_block_list.name: Event Host

text_block_list.text: Gulp! Aaahh... Thank you for the food—it was delicious!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото clears her plate! Her
insurmountable
strength pushes her to
the finish line!
text_block_list.name: Event Host

text_block_list.text: O-okay... I'll s-speed up!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Eeek! My plate! And m-my glass of
water!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Rattle! Craaaash!

Uh-oh, Мэйсё Дото has tipped over her
dishes!
This is sure to slow her down!
text_block_list.name: Event Host

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, I'm s-so sorry! Did I break
anything? I'm
sorry!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Wh-why am I like this? My hands get all
slippery
at the worst moments...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
In the end, Хиши Амадзон and El Condor
Pasa
finish in the time it takes Meisho
Doto to clean
up.

Hey, you were a tough one to beat... If it
weren't
for that accident, that win
would've easily been
yours.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I agree. I'm gonna come back stronger
next time,
so let's do this again!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Oh wow... you two think too highly of
me... I
w-would be honored!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Looks like I made a good
call—maintaining her
pace was the
answer. Мэйсё Дото's unbelievable

resistance to spice lands her a victory!

The three contestants exchange
handshakes.
After being deemed a
strong opponent, Meisho
Doto leaves
the experience more confident than

before.
